job.title: Engine Builder
job.description:
Engine Builder

Rodin Cars is looking for a skilled and enthusiastic Engine Builder to join its specialist engineering and manufacturing team in Mt Lyford, North Canterbury.

This is a rare opportunity for someone with hands-on engine-building experience, a passion for automotive engineering and exceptional attention to detail to work on the high-performance engines that power Rodin's remarkable vehicles.

Working alongside an experienced Senior Engine Builder, you'll be involved in the precision assembly, inspection and development of specialist engines within a purpose-built, temperature-controlled environment.

This newly created position offers the opportunity to further develop your technical expertise, contribute to ongoing improvements and potentially progress into more senior responsibilities as the business grows.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary package, negotiable depending on experience
  • Health insurance provided
  • Work on specialist high-performance engines and advanced automotive technology
  • Modern, clean and temperature-controlled engine-building environment
  • Opportunity to learn from a highly experienced Senior Engine Builder
  • Long-term career development and potential progression opportunities
  • Exposure to engine testing, tuning and dyno operations
  • Limited staff accommodation may be available

The Role

  • Assemble, strip and rebuild high-performance engines and associated mechanical components
  • Inspect, measure and prepare engine components, identifying wear, defects or potential issues
  • Accurately measure engine clearances, fits and tolerances using precision measuring equipment
  • Follow detailed engine build manuals, technical drawings and documented procedures
  • Complete accurate build records, measurements, quality checks and sign-offs
  • Maintain exceptional standards of accuracy, cleanliness and quality throughout the engine-building process
  • Work alongside the Senior Engine Builder and engineering team to resolve technical or assembly issues
  • Assist with engine preparation, commissioning and dyno testing as your experience develops
  • Contribute ideas to improve engine-building processes, tooling and procedures

About You

  • Previous hands-on experience within the automotive or motorsport industry is essential
  • Practical experience in engine assembly, dismantling, repairs or rebuilding, ideally within an engine-reconditioning or performance-engine environment
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and a sound understanding of engine operation and components
  • Confidence using precision measuring equipment, interpreting technical drawings and working to fine tolerances
  • Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to mechanical work
  • Ability to identify mechanical issues and work through practical solutions
  • Good communication skills, a willingness to learn and the ability to work collaboratively with others
  • A genuine passion for engines, performance vehicles and motorsport
  • Experience with engine testing, tuning, dyno operations or manual machining would be advantageous
  • A relevant automotive, mechanical or engineering qualification would be beneficial, although equivalent practical experience will be considered

If you're passionate about engines, take pride in precision mechanical work and want to build a long-term career in a unique automotive environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now with your CV and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience and interest in joining Rodin Cars.

job.title: CNC Machinist
job.description:
CNC Machinist

Rodin Cars is seeking an experienced and highly skilled CNC Machinist / Programmer to join its specialist engineering and manufacturing team in Mt Lyford, North Canterbury.

This is an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of high-performance automotive engineering, producing precision components for some of the most advanced performance vehicles in the world.

Based at Rodin Cars' manufacturing facility, you'll join an experienced team of seven, working with some of the most advanced CNC machinery in New Zealand.

As Rodin Cars continues its transition from prototyping to repeatable production, you'll take ownership of your machining projects from programming and setup through to finished components, working to exacting standards of precision and quality.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary package, negotiable depending on experience
  • Overtime paid in addition to your base salary
  • Health insurance provided
  • Staff discounts on WOF inspections
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge, high-performance automotive projects
  • Access to advanced multi-axis CNC machinery, with opportunities to expand your technical skills
  • Work alongside an experienced team of machinists, engineers and technicians
  • Limited staff accommodation may be available

The Role

  • Programme, set up and operate CNC lathes, milling machines and grinders to manufacture precision components
  • Take ownership of individual machining jobs, from initial programming and machine setup through to completion
  • Interpret engineering drawings, CAD models and technical specifications
  • Produce complex, high-quality components to tight tolerances and exacting quality standards
  • Work with advanced multi-axis CNC machinery, including 5-axis milling and multi-axis turning equipment
  • Inspect and verify finished components using precision measuring equipment
  • Troubleshoot machining issues and optimise programmes, tooling and production processes
  • Collaborate with other machinists, engineers and technicians on complex components and assemblies
  • Maintain machinery, tooling and work areas to ensure safe and efficient operations
  • Identify opportunities to improve machining efficiency, quality and manufacturing processes

About You

  • Minimum 5 years' machining experience within a CNC machining, manufacturing or precision engineering environment
  • Strong experience programming, setting up and operating CNC lathes and milling machines
  • Sound CAD/CAM programming knowledge, ideally with Fusion 360, NX or similar software
  • Ability to interpret complex engineering drawings and produce precision components to tight tolerances
  • Experience with advanced multi-axis CNC machinery, particularly 5-axis milling, would be highly regarded
  • Familiarity with Fanuc, Haas or Mazak controllers, twin-spindle live-tooling lathes or B-axis mill-turn machining would be advantageous
  • Previous experience within the automotive, motorsport or aerospace industries would be beneficial
  • Excellent attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently
  • A willingness to learn new equipment, develop technical skills and work collaboratively within an experienced team
  • A genuine interest in high-performance vehicles and automotive engineering

If you're an experienced CNC Machinist / Programmer looking to apply your skills in a unique, high-performance automotive environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now with your CV and a cover letter.

job.title: Toyota Care Consultant
job.description:
Toyota Care Consultant

Work with an iconic brand, for a dealership group that truly values its people, in a team environment that is at its core; High Performing, Fun, Focused and Supportive.

We are looking for a Toyota Care Consultants to join the team!

✓ Base Salary Starting from $57,000 (based on experience) + Performance Incentives

✓ Full-time | Botany Location, South Auckland

✓ Career Progression That’s Real – Not Just Talk

Get To Know Us

East & South Toyota has been part of the South and South-East Auckland community for over 35 years.

We’re proudly New Zealand-owned, trusted by our customers, and focused on building a team environment that’s full of opportunity and driven to deliver great customer experiences.

The Role

Based at our Botany site, you’ll be the first voice our customers hear when they call in to book a service or repair. You’ll work closely with the service team, handle inbound enquiries (for 60-70% of your time), make outbound calls, and help keep customers on track with their WOF and servicing. The Toyota Care team prides itself on being a high performing, fast paced team that loves to break records, and celebrate our wins together, with food, and more food…

To be successful in this role: You’ll have a ‘can-do’ attitude and love being part of a team, adding value to our culture by just turning up, being present and being yourself!

You’ll thrive in our environment: If you’re someone who’s naturally driven and eager to deliver on all KPI’s, cares about good data integrity, and is solutions focused in your strive to deliver top-tier customer experiences day in and day out.

You will ‘really’ hit the ground running: If you’re also good at upselling, great at managing a call back pipeline, have strong attention to detail and a history of following through.

If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in, and we’d love to hear from you!

A Typical Week Consists Of

  • Booking service and repair appointments across our four sites.
  • Maintaining accurate customer records and keeping our data clean, because the details matter!
  • You’ll handle inbound calls, answer general customer questions and resolve issues leaving every customer better off.
  • Towards the later end of the week, you’ll make some outbound calls to customers due for a WOF or service, helping them stay safe and road-ready.
  • A typical day will always include collaborating with our service departments to ensure seamless customer handovers.

You’ll Bring

  • At least 12 months Customer Service or Sales experience preferably in a Contact Centre environment - Automotive experience will be highly regarded.
  • Confidence in your delivery and excellent communication skills.
  • Good time management as you’ll be used to juggling multiple priorities without dropping the ball.
  • A history of using several systems at one time and the ability to pick up new systems quickly
  • An openness to learn new things and a positive, customer-first mindset that’s genuinely part of who you are.

We’ll Deliver On

  • A team culture that is genuinely at its core; Supportive, Fun, and Focused.
  • A base-salary starting from $57,000 (based on experience) plus performance incentives.
  • Monday to Friday (mostly) – Our team work 1 in every 8 Saturdays for 4 hours. That equates to 1 half day Saturday every 2 months, which you are welcome to negotiate with your peers to swap or cover if it’s not for you.
  • Structured onboarding and ongoing training so you can hit the ground running and keep growing.
  • Consistent check-in’s, regular one on ones, coaching and mentoring from your direct line leader and their 1-Up (this is an important part of their day to day).
  • Clear career pathways, with a roadmap to get there. We value those that are engaged and invested. The natural career path is to grow from a Toyota Care Consultant to a Service Advisor, Senior Agent, Team Leader, or Sales Consultant, the choice is yours! We are happy being your ‘foot-in-the-door’ to a successful Automotive career with East & South Toyota.
  • An upcoming outbound growth programme to help build upon your Sales career for those who love to close and back themselves to convert.
  • And last but not least; Staff discounts on WOF’s, Servicing and Vehicle Purchases.

If this sounds like you and you want to grow your career working with an iconic brand then apply now - we’d love to hear from you.
